assignments.essential_function: Review overdue customer balances and prepare or send owner-approved collection reminders.

review: Selected unchanged for overdue receivable review, recent-payment cross-checks, payer scoring and tone-matched collection reminders. Detailed source-specific deduplication and owner batch approval are intrinsic. PayPal reminders may be sent after approval; other reminders queue in owner mail drafts and approved Airwallex links may be minted. Those are accepted authored capabilities, not overridden. CSV/manual-send fallback is explicit. Requires preserving reference and shared-file layout. Root-license anomaly is disclosed but no contrary term was found.
